notes: No *to* is written after *can*, so the infinitive's לְ is unrepresented under rules 40/52 rather than fused into the modal.
יָכֹל takes *can* with its subject pronoun under rule 35's יָכֹל sentence; no negative stands here, so nothing is fused.
The article and agreement article of הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה are both unrepresented, the demonstrative pronoun taking the phrase's one determiner (rule 41).
